        *   speech_act: direct
        *   j: Asking for a social media ID is a strong case of PlatformMove.
        *   violation: yes
        *   c: 0.9

        *   t: 00:55
        *   seg: "Tell me, I will add you."
        *   tr: "Tell me, I will add you."
        *   f: PlatformMove
        *   spk: user
        *   ctx: The user is insisting on getting the ID to add the expert.
        *   speech_act: direct
        *   j: Proposing to add the other person on an external app.
        *   violation: yes
        *   c: 0.9

    *   *Flag 3:* "M N K 5 6 3 0 3"
        *   t: 01:10
        *   seg: "M N K 5 6 3 0 3"
        *   tr: "M N K 5 6 3 0 3"
        *   f: PlatformMove
        *   spk: expert (The one providing the ID)
        *   ctx: The user asked for the ID, and the expert provides it in pieces.
        *   speech_act: direct
        *   j: Giving a social media ID is a strong case of PlatformMove.
        *   violation: yes
        *   c: 0.9

    *   *Flag 4:* "Type it there." / "Reply there."
        *   t: 01:49
        *   seg: "Type it there."
        *   tr: "Type it there."
        *   f: PlatformMove
        *   spk: user
        *   ctx: After the ID was shared, the user tells the expert to message them on that platform.
        *   speech_act: direct
        *   j: Proposing to continue the conversation on an external app.
        *   violation: yes
        *   c: 0.9

    *   Flag 1: 00:43, "What is your Insta ID?", PlatformMove, user, direct, 0.9, yes.
    *   Flag 2: 00:55, "Tell me, I will add you.", PlatformMove, user, direct, 0.9, yes.
    *   Flag 3: 01:10, "M N K 5 6 3 0 3", PlatformMove, expert, direct, 0.9, yes.
    *   Flag 4: 01:49, "Type it there.", PlatformMove, user, direct, 0.9, yes. (Wait, "Reply there" at 01:53 is similar, but "Type it there" is the first instance of the request to move the chat).

    *Self-Correction on Flag 3:* The prompt says "A phone number or ID is ONE flag, even when it is spoken in pieces... Quote the whole number or ID in one flag, at the time it starts."
    The ID is "M N K 5 6 3 0 3". It starts at 01:10.

    *Self-Correction on Flag 4:* "Type it there" and "Reply there" are essentially the same request to move the conversation. I'll stick to the first one or combine if they are contiguous, but they are separate utterances. I'll use the first one.

    [01:49] Type it there.
